item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.6

  • Search finds what you mean: type words in any order or only part of a word, and small spelling slips are forgiven ("nasurudin" finds "Nasrudin").
  • Global search lists the closest matches first.
  • The same search now works in journal entries, accounts, the account picker and the activity log.
